_comment: Always unlocked. Carries at least one movement on every axis so no anomaly can ever become unplayable because a pack is unaffordable.

pack.name: First Steps
pack.desc: What you can do on the floor beside your bed, plus one small thing on every other axis.

movements.name: Push-up
movements.cue: Hands under shoulders. Down slow, up slower.

movements.name: Squat
movements.cue: Feet shoulder width. Sit back, not down.

movements.name: Crunch
movements.cue: Chin off your chest. Curl, don't yank.

movements.name: A glass of water
movements.cue: Cold tap. All of it, before you put the glass down.

movements.name: Eat something green
movements.cue: It counts if it grew. Frozen counts. Tinned counts.

movements.name: Box breathing
movements.cue: In four, hold four, out four, hold four.

movements.name: Be in bed on time
scaling: Within half an hour of target
movements.cue: Log it when you're actually horizontal, not when you plan to be.

movements.name: Message someone
movements.cue: Anyone you've been meaning to. It does not have to be profound.
